cell.name: The Broken Cell
cell.desc: A damp prison cell deep in Grimhold Keep. The iron door hangs broken on its hinges. Words are scratched into the mildewed wall.

corridor.name: The Torchlit Corridor
corridor.desc: A long corridor of weeping stone, a few torches still guttering in their sconces. Passages branch in several directions.

great_hall.name: The Ruined Great Hall
great_hall.desc: A vast hall of fallen banners and shattered tables. A crouching stone gargoyle glares from a plinth, and to the north a heavy iron portcullis bars the way to the vault.

crypt.name: The Crypt
crypt.desc: Rows of mouldering tombs. A cracked stone sarcophagus dominates the chamber, and a skeletal warden slumps against the far wall.

chapel.name: The Fallen Chapel
chapel.desc: A ruined chapel, its altar toppled among the rubble. An iron reliquary, sealed by a rune-etched lock, stands somehow intact.

vault.name: The Sealed Vault
vault.desc: A cold stone vault. On a raised plinth rests the Emberheart, a gem pulsing with trapped fire.

inscription.name: scratched words
inscription.examine: Words gouged into the wall: 'Only the charmed may wake the watcher of stone.'
inscription.read: 'Only the charmed may wake the watcher of stone.'

torch.name: guttering torch
torch.examine: A pitch-soaked torch, still burning — enough to see by in the dark.

sarcophagus.name: stone sarcophagus
sarcophagus.examine: A cracked sarcophagus, its lid shoved askew. Something lies within a searching hand's reach.

bone_charm.name: bone charm
bone_charm.examine: A charm of carved bone, oddly warm to the touch.

gargoyle.name: stone gargoyle
gargoyle.examine: A crouching gargoyle of black stone. A charm-shaped socket sits empty at its breast.

rune_key.name: rune-etched key
rune_key.examine: A heavy iron key etched with runes.

reliquary.name: iron reliquary
reliquary.examine: An iron reliquary sealed by a rune-etched lock.

silver_sigil.name: silver sigil
silver_sigil.examine: A silver sigil bearing the crest of Grimhold — shaped to seat in a great lock.

emberheart.name: Emberheart
emberheart.examine: A gem the size of a fist, pulsing with trapped fire. The prize.

rusty_sword.name: rusty longsword
rusty_sword.examine: A rusted longsword, its blade snapped a hand from the hilt. Useless now.

banner.name: tattered banner
banner.examine: A moth-eaten banner bearing a faded golden crest.

warden.name: the skeletal warden
warden.talk: The warden's jaw creaks open: 'The watcher of stone crouches in the ruined great hall, west of the corridor. Only the charmed may wake it — and charms sleep with the dead. Search where I have lain.'

last_events: You go north to The Torchlit Corridor.
